name: towel assisted one arm pull-up
description: A one-arm pull-up where the free hand holds a towel hung over the bar for a little help. Gripping the towel lower gives less help.
instructions: Hang a towel over the bar next to your working hand.
Grip the bar with one hand and the towel with the other.
Pull up mostly with the bar arm, using the towel hand only as needed.
Bring your chin over the bar and lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
